interpretation_owners.traversal_cost: route-finder cost callback; navgrid assigns no built-in terrain cost
interpretation_owners.height: application-defined unitless metadata; navgrid and route-finder do not interpret it
interpretation_owners.solid: no distinct navcell state; callers express it through blocked policy

legacy_mutation_policy.block_non_forbidden: refuse and preserve terrain and height
legacy_mutation_policy.unblock_forbidden: remove cell and restore sparse default
legacy_mutation_policy.unblock_non_forbidden: refuse and preserve terrain and height
legacy_mutation_policy.overlay_provenance: checked block uses a separate default overlay; token and maze/obstacle source overlays preserve base terrain and each other

checked_mutation_policy.set_cell: validated failure-atomic base replacement with prior presence value and changed outputs
checked_mutation_policy.fetch_cell: inside absent returns NORMAL height 0 with present false; outside returns NOT_FOUND and preserves outputs
checked_mutation_policy.block_unblock: mutate only the default blocked overlay and preserve the base cell
checked_mutation_policy.clear: removes base cells and all overlays while preserving extent topology and callback binding
checked_mutation_policy.overlay_remove: removes only the selected token or source and reveals remaining overlays or base terrain
